caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate, carved wooden scroll element that appears to be a decorative architectural or furniture piece, such as a corbel or bracket. The object is shown against a plain, light beige background with no additional elements present. The scroll has a curled, spiral upper section and a pointed lower end, with carved, leaf-like and wave motifs on its surface. The wood is rendered in shades of brown and dark brown, with variably lighter and darker areas suggesting the grain and aged patina of the wood. Small holes are visible along the outer edge and within the body of the object, possibly for mounting or attachment. The name "Eugene Bartz" and the date "1938" are centered in small text beneath the drawing.
title: Leaf and Scroll
